title: 10 Best Ruta Graveolens Preparations

Oils are often used in topical applications to alleviate muscle pain and inflammation. Decoctions, made by boiling the herb, are valued for their soothing effects on the digestive system. Syrups are commonly used to ease respiratory issues and support immune health.
